notes.title: Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello Pioneer,

We are happy to announce that we have a new update for the demo!
Based on your feedback we added new features and made some improvements - bug fixes, performance, build size....
Expect a smoother frame-rate and a lot more settings you can tweak in the options menu.

Features:
- Map pin
- Look back when driving
- You can now bind dash to a standalone button
- Options updated with settings for shadows, LODs and tree distance
- Trees from unloaded chunks can now be rendered if using a higher render tree distance
- Bus damage is now visible on the model
- Enemies now attack the bus
- Destructible objects added like streetlights, streetlights and boxes, making driving much easier
- Special group of enemies and events where you can risk it for the biscuit
- Turrets!
- New events for the towers
- Changed pick up all items to a single button
- Significantly decreased initial loading time
- Many visual changes to help with readability
- Improved sound performance
- New sounds and ambiances
- Full controller support (We tested with Sony DualSense, Sony DualShock 4, Xbox One/Series, Nintendo Switch Pro)
- We tested the game on Steam Deck with Proton 9.0 compatibility and it's running with a fairly stable 30 fps 


Fixes:
- Much better performance
- We compressed and removed some useless objects to drastically decrease build size (From 15.1 GB down to about 3.1 GB)
- Sound fixes to enemies and ambiance
- Many enemy fixes
- Improved loot spawning
- FX and visual tweaks for readability
- UI fixes
- Fuel now affects the bus 
- Improved chunk spawning times and distance

Thank you for the support and feedback, it really helped a lot. 

Just like last time if you find any bugs feel free to report them on steam or our discord.

It took us this long because we have been actively working on the multiplayer. We wanted to add the multiplayer to the demo but decided it would be better to do a closed beta so we can work with players more closely to fix bugs or issues they have. We'll publish more info here and on our discord when we are starting with the closed beta so keep an eye out for that.
  
And if you want to give us more support, don't forget to wishlist the game if you haven't already!

Thank you and see you in Skopje, Pioneers!

notes.title: The first Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Dark-1 team. 

We are so happy that people are finally able to play Skopje '83. Testing the game ourselves has many disadvantages and we have a lot of blind spots so your feedback is really helpful and very appreciated.

In the newest version we have fixed the most critical problems and bugs which include:
[list]
[*]Resources and items are way more common
[*]We fixed the RAM usage issue
[*]Enemies should no longer run to a specific point on the map on new runs
[*]Better enemy navigation around the world
[*]We fixed some missing quest interactions
[*]We fixed the missing hallway interior of a specific building
[/list]
We also did a lot minor visual and functional fixes that were not so critical.

Known issues we will be fixing in the coming days:
[list]
[*]Sometimes the LOD of the terrain will be visible when it shouldn't be.
[*]Sometimes an item with 0 stack appears in crates and the game can get stuck in loading screen. If you encounter items in crates that show 0 as the amount, do not pick them up!
[/list]

Thank you all for the great and constructive feedback, it really helps. We will do our best to fix all the issues and bugs while also adding a lot of quality of life tweaks to make your stay in Skopje as engaging it can be.
If you encounter any issues, don't hesitate to post them on our discord, or the community hub right here on steam!
Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/HfXf8z7JNv]https://discord.gg/HfXf8z7JNv[/url]

See you in Skopje, Pioneers!

notes.title: Big News
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it’s been a long time since you heard from us and we are happy to say we bring big news.

We updated our game title from "Skopje" to "[b]Skopje '83[/b]".
We were afraid that “Skopje” as a title will never surpass the real life city of Skopje in search engines and it will be difficult for people to look up the game. So we decided to put a little ‘83 (the year the game is set in) so it will be easier to find. With that comes a new logo, take a peak:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38354940/c8cc99624221405e9bd790eec0e845edfc2bdd62.png[/img]

Now even better news!
At this moment we are at IGN Live where people are trying out a demo of “Skopje ‘83”. We also debuted a new trailer at the event but don't worry you can check it out here:

[previewyoutube=G0gxg354kC0;full][/previewyoutube]

And finally for the most exciting news, you will be able to try a demo of "Skopje '83" on Steam Next Fest. 
You will have a chance to free roam a pretty big chunk of the game, so we are very exited to see where the road takes you.
With all that in mind, expect some issues, bugs and unpolished visual at some places.

Just don't forget to go easy on us and if you encounter any issues and have the time please report them to us on our official discord: [url=https://discord.gg/nweJ47tyyb]https://discord.gg/nweJ47tyyb[/url] 

That's all for now. Hope to see you in Skopje, Pioneers!

notes.title: Why is this in my wishlist, remind me again?
notes.content:
Hi there! 

Look around, leaves are brown, and the sky is a hazy shade of winter. But that hasn’t stopped us from actively working on Skopje. It may have slowed us down along with the entire pandemic situation, but we’re still on track. It’s been quite a while since we showed up here, so why not kick off the year with an update?

Before we dive in, we’d like to wish you all the best in the year ahead, loads of games, plenty of luck, joy and happiness! Hopefully things this year will be better than the last.

Well, back to Skopje. Slowly, but surely we’re wrapping up the playable alpha version of the game together. There have been loads of visual improvements since the first early alpha gameplay footage that we posted back in September, including, but not limited to improved shaders and anti-aliasing, decals, environmental details, and visual effects. We’ve also been working on training the mutated abominations how and when to attack you and some basic forms of communication. Somewhere along the way they learned to break the laws of physics and questioned the possibility of living in a holographic simulation, but we took care of that. We also managed to get DOM (your mobile base) functional, meaning you can drive it around, store your stuff to make more stuff, and sleep safely.

There’s a bunch of other stuff, but we’re gonna stop right here before we spoil the game.

Okay, we’re gonna spoil you a little bit with some fresh new gifs, don’t tell the others.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Oy1EK2Y.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uypLb9x.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OhPvVA4.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7hYzIVc.gif[/img]

We’re always happy to talk more about Skopje, so why not come aboard on Discord? Here’s an invite, so help yourself out: https://discord.gg/raQqSfQ. We do our best to do regular updates and dev logs.

You’re in too many servers already? That’s alright, we’re also on [url=https://twitter.com/Dark1_games]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/dark1games/]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/dark1games/]Instagram[/url]. 

Thanks for tagging along!

Until next time,
Dark-1 Games
